title: Make the VIXEN error-catalog check bootstrap generated outputs
body: A fresh queued native target build failed before compilation because codegen/error-catalog/index.json was missing and error_catalog_check had no generating dependency. Recovery required a separate queued build target: build.bat build vixen-ninja error_catalog_regen, then the requested vixen_error_catalog_smoke target passed. Make the check derive or depend on regeneration for a fresh tree, or publish one supported target that materializes and checks the catalog together.
